Stated plainly

Biorhythm theory, popular since the 1970s, says three cycles start on the day you were born: physical over 23 days, emotional over 28 and intellectual over 33. When researchers compared the curves with accidents, sports results, exam scores and moods, they did no better than chance, and a 1998 review of 134 studies concluded that the theory is not supported (Hines, <cite>Psychological Reports</cite>, 1998).

So Biotide treats the curves as a starting guess you can test, never as a prediction. Your own check-ins decide how much each curve counts. Apple Health signals are compared with your own usual, never with norms, and nothing is diagnosed. Biotide is for reflection and planning, not medical advice: if you feel unwell, talk to a doctor.

Frequently asked questions
What is a biorhythm?

A biorhythm is one of three cycles that, according to a theory popular since the 1970s, start on the day you were born: physical over 23 days, emotional over 28 days and intellectual over 33 days. Biotide works out all three from your birth date and draws them as a daily biorhythm chart.
How is Biotide different from other biorhythm apps?

Most biorhythm apps draw the curves and tell you how your day will go. Biotide also asks you, with a thirty-second evening check-in of energy, mood, focus and sleep. With Biotide Plus, after 14 check-ins it shows how often each curve matched how you felt, and a curve that doesn’t fit you counts for less in your readings and plans, or drops out entirely.
What are critical days in a biorhythm?

Critical days are the days a cycle crosses zero, on its way from the high half to the low half or back. Biotide calls them transition days and marks them before they arrive; the theory treats them as sensitive days for that cycle.
How does biorhythm compatibility work?

Biotide compares your three cycles with another person's, worked out from both birthdays, and shows how closely they line up as a match percentage. It also shows, day by day, which days look good for the two of you, such as the next good day for an important conversation. Compatibility is part of Biotide Plus.
What does Biotide cost?

Biotide is free to download, with no ads. Today’s chart, your day in words, the evening check-in, reminders and export are free. Biotide Plus, an optional weekly, monthly or yearly subscription or a one-time purchase, adds people and compatibility, Prime days and the forecast calendar, how often each curve fits you with readings tuned to it, Apple Health, Tidy, iCloud sync and every widget.
Can I ask Biotide questions about my days?

Yes, with Biotide Plus on an iPhone with Apple Intelligence, in English. Ask Tidy something like “When’s a good day for a hard talk with Anna?” or “What’s my day like tomorrow?” Biotide looks the answer up in your own chart, check-ins, Apple Health signals and people, Apple’s on-device model puts it into words, and the days or curves behind it are drawn under the reply. Your questions never leave the iPhone.
Is my data private?

Yes. Biotide has no account and no servers of its own: your birth date, check-ins and people stay on your device, or in your own iCloud if you turn on sync. Apple Health data is only read, never written, and never leaves the device, and Tidy answers on the iPhone itself. The app counts which screens and features are used, through Google Analytics for Firebase, never what you enter, and you can turn that off in Settings. The privacy policy has the details.
Which devices does Biotide run on?
iPhone with iOS 26 or later, with widgets for the Home Screen and the Lock Screen. There is no iPad or Android version.
Who makes Biotide?
Biotide is an independent app, and biotide.app is its official website. Questions go to support@biotide.app.

Privacy Policy
Last updated: November 23, 2026

Biotide ("we", "our", or "the app") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we and our service providers handle when you use our iOS application, the biotide.app website, and related services.

The short version: Biotide has no account, no server of its own and no advertising. What you enter and what the app reads from Apple Health stays on your device. We never see it. The app counts which of its screens and features are used, without any of that data, and you can turn this off in Settings.
Information We Collect
Biotide does not require account registration or login.
Stored locally on your device only:
Your birth date, used to draw your three cycles
Your daily check-ins: energy, mood, focus and sleep ratings, and an optional note
The people you add: name, birthday, relation, and a photo if you choose one
App settings, such as reminder times
This information is kept in the app's private storage on your device. The widgets read your birth date from a storage area shared only between Biotide and its widgets.

If you choose to connect Apple Health (part of Biotide Plus), Biotide reads four types: sleep analysis, heart rate variability, resting heart rate and respiratory rate. Nothing is read until you allow it in the system permission sheet. Biotide compares these values with your own previous 28 days on your device and shows the result in the app. Once there are 14 days of them, it also uses them on your device to test how well your physical curve fits you.

Biotide never writes to Apple Health, never copies Health data off your device, never stores it in iCloud, and never uses it for advertising or shares it with anyone. You can turn off access at any time in the Health app or in Settings, Privacy & Security, Health.
Tidy

Tidy, part of Biotide Plus on iPhones with Apple Intelligence, answers questions about your days. Biotide looks the answer up in the data already on your device, and Apple's on-device language model puts it into words. Your questions and Tidy's answers are processed on your iPhone, are never sent to us or anyone else, and are not kept after you close Tidy.
Contacts

If you allow it, Biotide reads the names, birthdays and photos in your contacts to show everyone with a birthday in People. iOS lets you share all your contacts or only the ones you choose, and you can change that at any time in Settings. What Biotide keeps stays on your device and is never uploaded. You can also add a single person through the system contact picker, which gives Biotide only that contact.
iCloud Sync

iCloud sync, part of Biotide Plus, is off until you turn it on in the app's Settings, under Data & Sync. When it is on, your birth date, check-ins and the people you added (with any photo you chose for them) are stored in your own private iCloud database through Apple's CloudKit, so your other Apple devices can show them. This sync is operated by Apple, not by us, and is subject to Apple's Privacy Policy. We cannot read your iCloud. Apple Health data, contact photos and your contacts themselves never sync. When you turn sync off, you can choose to delete Biotide's data from iCloud.
Calendar and Notifications

Adding a day to your calendar uses the system calendar editor; Biotide does not read your calendar. Check-in reminders and transition-day notes are scheduled on your device, and you can turn them off in the app or in Settings.
Purchases

Biotide Plus subscriptions and the one-time purchase are handled by Apple through the App Store. We do not receive your payment details, your Apple ID or your name; the app only learns whether Plus is active on your account.
Usage Statistics in the App
The app tells us which of its screens and features are used, so we know what to improve. It does this through Google Analytics for Firebase, a Google service. It is on unless you turn it off.

What is sent: events such as a check-in being saved (never its ratings or note), a chart zoom chip or a Plan menu being used, a person being added (never who), Apple Health being connected, a purchase or restore finishing, and which screens are opened; and a few settings in broad bands, such as whether reminders, Apple Health or iCloud sync are on, which plan you have, and how many people or check-ins you have as a range. Firebase adds a random app-instance identifier, the device model, iOS and app version, language, and an approximate location (country or region) that Google derives from the network address.

What is never sent: your birth date or age, your check-in ratings and notes, any Apple Health value, anything about the people you add (names, birthdays, photos, match percentages), the dates you look at, what you ask Tidy, or anything else you type. The app sends only a fixed list of event names and values, with no way to pass free text.

No advertising and no tracking: the app does not use the advertising identifier (IDFA), Google signals and data sharing are switched off, and this data is not combined with data from other companies' apps or websites.
Retention: Google Analytics keeps the event data for 14 months; we see it only as totals.
Turning it off: switch off Share Usage Statistics in the app's Settings, under Data & Sync, and the app stops sending and asks Google Analytics to clear what it has collected on that device.
Third-Party Service Providers
Depending on how you use the app and this website, the following third parties may process data:
Apple — App Store distribution and, if enabled, iCloud sync — Privacy Policy
Google (Firebase) — Google Analytics for Firebase, the app's usage statistics (can be turned off in Settings) — Google Privacy Policy
Google Analytics — optional website analytics on this site (the app's usage statistics are described above) — Google Privacy Policy

Cloudflare Web Analytics — cookieless, aggregate page-view counts on this site only (not in the app); it sets no cookies, stores nothing in your browser, and does not identify or track you across sites — Cloudflare Web Analytics
Website Analytics and Consent
This website uses one optional measurement tool, Google Analytics, which tells us how the site is used. Whether it runs before you make a choice depends on where you are:
European Economic Area: Google Analytics is not loaded until you select “Accept” in the banner.

United Kingdom: Google Analytics runs from your first page view to produce aggregate statistics that help us improve the site, as UK law permits, with Google Signals and ad personalisation switched off. “Turn off” disables it.
Switzerland and everywhere else: Google Analytics runs from your first page view, and the banner lets you turn it off.

Your choice is stored in your browser and applies to later visits. We determine the region from your device’s time zone and language settings, treating unclear European cases under the European Economic Area rules, and Google’s Consent Mode additionally applies the European Economic Area default based on your network location. This website does not change its behavior in response to browser Do Not Track signals; use “Cookie Settings” instead.

When it runs, Google Analytics may process the page viewed, referring page, timestamp, browser and device characteristics, screen size, approximate location derived from the network request, and clicks on App Store download links. It does not receive your name, email address, or anything from the app. We do not show ads on this site or in the app.

You can change your choice at any time through “Cookie Settings” in the footer. Turning analytics off after it was running immediately disables future analytics events and reloads the page without the Google Analytics script.

Separately from Google Analytics, this website counts page views with Cloudflare Web Analytics. It runs without the banner because it uses no cookies, stores nothing on your device, and does not build a profile of you: Cloudflare receives the page viewed, the referring page, and coarse browser and country information, and reports them to us only as aggregate totals.
Data We Do Not Collect
We never receive your name, email, phone number, address, or any other identifying information. The names and birthdays you enter for people stay on your device.
We do not require account creation or login.
We do not sell, rent, or trade any data to third parties for advertising or any other purpose.
We do not use cookies in the iOS app, and it does not track you across other companies' apps or websites.
Data Retention and Your Control
All app data is stored locally on your device (and in your own iCloud if you turned on sync). You control it at any time:
Edit or delete single check-ins and people within the app
Export everything as JSON, or your check-ins as CSV, in the app's Settings, under Data & Sync
Delete all data from the app in the same place; with iCloud sync on, this deletes it from iCloud too
Uninstall the app, which deletes its data on that device
European Users (GDPR)

If you are in the European Economic Area, United Kingdom, or Switzerland, you have the following rights under the General Data Protection Regulation regarding personal data we process about you (limited to the app's usage statistics and the website measurement described above; everything else in the app stays on your device):
Right of access — request a copy of the data we hold
Right to rectification — request correction of inaccurate data
Right to erasure — request deletion of your data
Right to restrict or object to processing
Right to data portability
Right to lodge a complaint with your national data-protection authority

The legal basis for the app's usage statistics is our legitimate interest in learning which features are used so we can improve the app (GDPR Article 6(1)(f)); you can object at any time by turning them off in the app's Settings, under Data & Sync. The legal basis for cookieless aggregate page-view counting with Cloudflare Web Analytics is our legitimate interest in knowing how many people read this site (GDPR Article 6(1)(f)); it involves no cookies or identifiers. In the European Economic Area, the legal basis for Google Analytics is your consent under GDPR Article 6(1)(a), which you can withdraw at any time through Cookie Settings. In the United Kingdom, Switzerland and elsewhere, Google Analytics runs on our legitimate interest in understanding how the site is used so we can improve it, and you can object at any time through Cookie Settings. To exercise any right above, email privacy@biotide.app; we will respond within 30 days.
California Users (CCPA / CPRA)
If you are a California resident, you have the following rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act and California Privacy Rights Act regarding personal information we process:
Right to know what categories of personal information we collect and how we use them
Right to delete personal information we hold (subject to legal exceptions)
Right to correct inaccurate personal information
Right to opt out of any "sale" or "sharing" of personal information — we do not sell or share personal information, so this opt-out is effectively always active for our users
Right to non-discrimination for exercising these rights
To exercise these rights, email privacy@biotide.app.
Data Security
Your data stays on your device under iOS's protections. Any traffic from the app or this website is encrypted with HTTPS/TLS. We have no access to your Apple ID or payment details.
Children's Privacy

The app is not directed at children under the age of 13 in the United States, or under the age of 16 in the European Economic Area. We do not knowingly collect information from children below these ages. If you believe we have inadvertently received such information, please contact us and we will delete it.
